diagnosis: Private networking is not yet available in ap-south per kb-0008, so the enable request remained queued rather than failing. No entitlement issue is present since this is a regional availability limitation, not a plan restriction.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Private networking is currently available in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, but it is not yet available in ap-south. Because of this, requests to enable it in unsupported regions like yours remain queued rather than failing, which is why you didn't see anything happen. We'd suggest watching our announcements for availability in additional regions.
